title: 完整人工智能超级课程2026：从基础到企业AI
summary: 一个覆盖AI全栈学习路径的开源课程仓库，从Python、数学、机器学习到深度学习、Transformer与LLM、RAG、Agent、MCP、多模态、评估安全及MLOps，最终以综合项目收尾。
summary_en: An open-source curriculum repo covering the full AI learning path, from Python, math, and ML to deep learning, Transformers & LLMs, RAG, agents, MCP, multimodal AI, evaluation, security, and MLOps, ending with a capstone.
